questions.question: Evaluate the indefinite integral ∫(2x + 3) dx.
questions.explanation: ∫(2x+3)dx = 2·(x²/2) + 3x + C = x² + 3x + C. We integrate each term using the power rule: ∫xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C.

questions.question: A card is drawn from a well-shuffled deck of 52 cards. The probability of getting a spade is:
questions.explanation: \( There are 13 spades \in 52 cards. P(spade) = \frac{13}{52} = \frac{1}{4}. \)

questions.question: A relation R on a set A is reflexive if:
options: A) (a,b) ∈ R and (b,c) ∈ R implies (a,c) ∈ R
B) (a,a) ∈ R for all a ∈ A

questions.question: \( Find the domain of the function: The domain of f(x) = \sqrt{x+1} is: \)
questions.explanation: \( The domain is the set of all x-values for which the function is defined. For \sqrt{x+1} to be real, x+1 ≥ 0, so x ≥ -1. \)

questions.question: The order of the differential equation d²y/dx² + 3(dy/dx)² + y = 0 is:
questions.explanation: The order is the highest derivative present, which is d²y/dx² (order 2).

questions.question: \( Evaluate the limit: \lim(x→0) (\sin x)/x equals: \)
questions.explanation: \( We use standard limit formulas and techniques. This is a standard limit: \lim(x→0) \sin(x)/x = 1. \)

questions.question: The slope of the tangent to the curve y = x² at x = 2 is:
questions.explanation: The derivative dy/dx gives the slope of the tangent line at any point. dy/dx = 2x. At x = 2, slope = 2(2) = 4. This geometric interpretation connects calculus to coordinate geometry.

questions.question: For a binomial distribution with n = 5 and p = 0.4, the mean is:
questions.explanation: Mean of binomial distribution = np = 5 × 0.4 = 2.

questions.question: Find the value: If A = [1 2; 3 4], then A^T equals:
questions.explanation: The transpose swaps rows and columns: A^T = [1 3; 2 4]. This result follows from standard mathematical principles.

questions.question: A ladder 5 m long slides down a wall. When the bottom is 3 m from the wall and moving at 1 m/s, how fast is the top sliding down?
questions.explanation: \( x² + y² = 25. Differentiating: 2x(dx/dt) + 2y(dy/dt) = 0. When x=3, y=4: 2(3)(1) + 2(4)(dy/dt) = 0, so dy/dt = -\frac{6}{8} = -\frac{3}{4} m/s. Speed = \frac{3}{4} m/s. \)

questions.question: Two bags: Bag 1 has 2 red and 3 blue balls; Bag 2 has 3 red and 2 blue balls. A bag is chosen at random and a ball is drawn. If the ball is red, what is the probability it came from Bag 1?
questions.explanation: \( Using Bayes' theorem: P(Bag1\left| \1 \right|Bag1)·P(Bag1) / [P(Red\left| \1 \right|Bag2)·P(Bag2)] = (\frac{2}{5})(\frac{1}{2}) / [(\frac{2}{5})(\frac{1}{2}) + (\frac{3}{5})(\frac{1}{2})] = (\frac{1}{5}) / (\frac{1}{2}) = \frac{2}{5}. \)

questions.question: \( The \sum of the first 10 terms of the arithmetic progression 2, 5, 8, ... is: \)
questions.explanation: \( First term a = 2, common difference d = 3. Sum of first n terms: S_n = n/2 × (2a + (n-1)d). S₁₀ = \frac{10}{2} × (2×2 + 9×3) = 5 × (4 + 27) = 5 × 31 = 155. \)

questions.question: Find the inverse of the matrix: If A = [1 2; 3 4], then A⁻¹ equals:
questions.explanation: \( For a 2×2 matrix [[a,b],[c,d]], the inverse is (1/\left| \1 \right|)[[d,−b],[−c,a]]. \left| \1 \right| = 1×4 - 2×3 = -2. adj(A) = [4 -2; -3 1]. A⁻¹ = adj(A)/\left| \1 \right| = 1/(-2)[4 -2; -3 1]. \)

questions.question: The integrating factor of the differential equation dy/dx + (2/x)y = x² is:
questions.explanation: \( For dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x), integrating factor = e^{(∫P(x)}dx). Here P(x) = 2/x, so IF = e^{(∫2/x dx)} = e^{(2ln\left| \1 \right|)} = e^{(\ln x²)} = x². \)

questions.question: The function f(x) = x³ - 3x² is increasing on which interval?
questions.explanation: f'(x) = 3x² - 6x = 3x(x-2). f'(x) > 0 when x < 0 or x > 2. So f is increasing on (-∞,0) ∪ (2,∞).

questions.question: If A is a square matrix satisfying A² = A + I, then A⁵ equals:
questions.explanation: A² = A + I. A³ = A·A² = A(A+I) = A² + A = 2A + I. A⁴ = A·A³ = A(2A+I) = 2A² + A = 3A + 2I. A⁵ = A·A⁴ = A(3A+2I) = 3A² + 2A = 5A + 3I.

questions.question: The shortest distance between the skew lines L₁: r = i + j + t(2i - j + k) and L₂: r = 2i + k + s(i + j - k) is:
questions.explanation: \( Let a₁ = i+j, b₁ = 2i-j+k, a₂ = 2i+k, b₂ = i+j-k. a₂-a₁ = i-k. b₁×b₂ = \left| \1 \right| = i(1-1) - j(-2-1) + k(2+1) = 3j + 3k. (a₂-a₁)·(b₁×b₂) = (i-k)·(3j+3k) = -3. \left| \1 \right| = \sqrt{9+9} = 3\sqrt{2}. Distance = \left| \1 \right|/(3\sqrt{2}) = 1/\sqrt{2}. \)

questions.question: Solve dy/dx + 2y = 0 with y(0) = 3. The value of y(1) is:
questions.explanation: \( Separating variables: dy/y = -2dx. Integrating: \ln\left| \1 \right| = -2x + C₁, so y = Ce^{(-2x)}. Using y(0)=3: C=3. So y = 3e^{(-2x)}. At x=1: y(1) = 3e⁻². \)

questions.question: \( The maximum volume of a cylinder inscribed \in a sphere of radius R is: \)
questions.explanation: \( Let cylinder have radius r and height h. From geometry: r² + (h/2)² = R². Volume V = πr²h = π(R² - h²/4)h = π(R²h - h³/4). dV/dh = π(R² - 3h²/4) = 0 → h = 2R/\sqrt{3}. Then r² = R² - R²/3 = 2R²/3. V = π(2R²/3)(2R/\sqrt{3}) = 4πR³/(3\sqrt{3}). \)
